baseline.volume_unit: mm^3 as labelled by publisher; not independently recomputed
baseline.missing_value_policy: No global imputation; training-fold median after log1p
baseline.selection: strict M0, positive follow-up, no blocking outcome/surgery flags

configuration.tie_break: largest alpha within 1e-12 of best score
configuration.feature_selection: fixed nine-feature panel; no outcome-based filtering
configuration.preprocessing: median then standard scale fitted separately in each inner/outer training fold
configuration.death_handling: same as baseline; death is censored, not a distant event
configuration.sensitivity: exclude death_gap, retain primary outer folds

tuning.selection_metric: Harrell C by within-inner-fold pair totals
